body: The canonical redirect for mis-cased symbols returns <Navigate> but usePerpsAbandonOrderTracking.active is already true because market exists. Redirect unmount emits false abandon_order before order form appears. Gate active on market?.symbol === decodedSymbol and add redirect teardown test proving no abandon event.
action: Gated abandon tracking on the exact symbol (with a market guard) and added a redirect teardown test that fails without the fix.
